findings.summary: Off-by-one lets the Intervals.icu path run one page past the stated MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES cap.
findings.mechanism: hasMoreIntervals queues another page while payload.page <= MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES (24), so a page-24 job still queues page 25, which then gets processed — 25 pages run (~4 years + 2 months) instead of the intended 24 (~4 years) the comment describes. Should be `payload.page < MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES`.
